offering_description.value: Provides engineering and scientific consulting, failure analysis and forensic investigations to businesses, law firms and government agencies. Teams of engineers and scientists deliver the work through projects billed on time or fixed fees.

primary_services.value: engineering consulting; failure analysis; forensic investigation; scientific testing; regulatory compliance consulting; expert witness services

customer_segment.value: B2B: corporations, insurers, law firms, manufacturers, technology and energy companies; B2G: government agencies and public bodies

end_markets.value: transportation; energy; chemicals; consumer products; construction; healthcare; technology; government

revenue_model.value: service fees: fees for engineering and scientific staff time on client work; project or contract: fixed-fee investigations and consulting projects

value_chain_position.value: service provider: takes in client questions and technical problems, sells expert analysis and consulting to clients

geography_served.value: global: US offices across several states, plus offices in Europe and Asia

specialization.value: related lines: engineering, scientific, forensic and regulatory consulting sharing technical staff and expertise

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct selling to corporate clients, law firms and government agencies

regulatory_exposure.value: low: only normal business rules apply to a consulting firm, some client work touches regulated product areas
